text: I tested 13 different habit tracking apps and this was in the top three. It works well but it doesn't have a "Goals" option, just habits, therefore I've subscribed to an app that also tracks the steps it takes to complete your individual goals. The third app in the top three, wasn't as colorful but it was free. If you're looking for some help with things that you need to be reminded to do, this app will do that. I also liked that I could choose different colors for different habits and the stats are easy to understand. I also wanted an app that would help me track the steps towards completing goals and this doesn't have that feature. This app does have "Journeys" aka "challenges" on the paid version but I have MyFitnessPal for that. All in all, if the app I've subscribed to doesn't work out, this is one I'd reconsider.

author: Carry Davis

text: I'll do the honors of the first review. the app was great, i was totally enjoying it. you could create and customize your own habits with many cool features and icons. the color options were limited but we could do with it. the fact that it needed to run in the background all the time drains ram but we could do with that too. the problem starts when even the most basic feature, creating more than 5 habits will require you to go premium. i hope this helped to realize your mistakes.
author: Godstep Lover
developer_reply: Hi there, thanks for the valuable feedback. Sorry for the inconvenience caused. To meet your needs for the basic feature, we have increased the number of habits you can create for free in the latest version. As we are a small and growing team, we do need support for running costs and we would appreciate your understanding. Best regards.
